data.name: Purshotam
data.gender_notes: Purshotam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has attained the divine lotus feet of Lord Vishnu. The name Purshotam carries the meaning “Devotee of Vishnu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Purshotam usually hope their child will grow to embody devotee of vishnu and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the ultimate goal of attaining Moksha (liberation) and the blessings of Lord Vishnu
data.etymology: Purshotam belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devotee of Vishnu.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Purshotam total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Purshotam" is of great reverence in Hindu culture, as it denotes someone who has achieved the pinnacle of spiritual enlightenment by attaining the divine lotus feet of Lord Vishnu. This name is often associated with purity, devotion, and a deep connection to the divine. It is also a sign of respect and admiration within the Hindu community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Purshotam" represents the ultimate goal of every Hindu - to attain the grace and blessings of Lord Vishnu, who is the protector and preserver of the universe. The name signifies a deep sense of devotion and longing for the divine, as well as a strong commitment to living a virtuous and righteous life. It also serves as a constant reminder of the importance of spiritual growth and self-realization, as one strives to become a true devotee of Lord Vishnu and attain the divine lotus feet in this or future births.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Purshotam: Radiant in Dharma (righteousness). A beacon of virtuous living, illuminating the path to ultimate truth.
